qa.what_happened: I had to remain silent during quiet hours, which was unusual since the residents did well following the rules. The study was unexpectedly halted, leaving me to wonder about its true purpose.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving my honest reflection during the private debrief.

qa.what_happened: Today was praised by the lead researcher, Coordinator Keane, and Coordinator Garza, and the residents complied with the rules throughout the day. The quiet hours were particularly noteworthy as the residents stayed silent, maintaining the necessary discipline.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me enforcing the rules and giving the praises to the residents.

qa.what_happened: I complied with all instructions during the day and remained silent during the quiet hours, even though the praise from the coordinators felt hollow.
